summary: Both research watches are now reconciled. The usage watch reports 53 community cases and five mechanisms/fixes; these are imported totals, separate from nine individually reviewed usage reports. New context-overhead evidence and a watch-only image-replay report have been read. The watches disagree about the September 19 comment: we retain an ambiguous hint, no announced reset or Tuesday deadline, and ELEVATED banked outlook with low confidence.
historyNote: Imported from previous research: the original Reset Watch conversation and its scheduled reports. Public claims and original links are retained; private account observations are excluded. Imported claims are not newly verified primary evidence. Exact post times and relative Help Center update dates have not been promoted to verified timestamps. Version 4 also imports dated usage-watch summaries. Their totals and outlooks retain separate provenance from individually reviewed sources.

incidents.title: Repeated agent work consumed a large allowance
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: Reporter describes roughly 42% weekly usage for a scoped task, repeated enumeration and no-op delegation.
incidents.limitation: Self-reported usage; independent root cause and compensation eligibility are not established.

incidents.title: Reset notification shows a different timezone
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: The report compares the notification time with Settings and mobile, which display a different reset time.
incidents.limitation: A display discrepancy does not demonstrate failed quota restoration.

incidents.title: Goal compaction exceeded an input-item limit
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: The report includes an array-length error during a long review-to-goal session and describes a subsequent wait.
incidents.limitation: The structural error is documented by the reporter; the additional usage cost and later internal state are not measured here.

incidents.title: Status command was sent to the model
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: A command intended to inspect Fast mode reportedly became a normal model turn with file reads.
incidents.limitation: A current-version source fix has not been independently reviewed here.

incidents.title: Usage display and later enforcement disagree
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: Reporter says both windows appeared restored after a manual reset, followed shortly by a five-hour limit.
incidents.limitation: Reset type is unspecified. The uploaded private trace was not inspected; cause remains unresolved.

incidents.title: Trivial commands repeated after reconnects
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: The report describes a fresh workspace, repeated successful tool calls, compaction and timeouts.
incidents.limitation: Repeated work is described, but no independent quota-cost measurement was established here.

incidents.title: Background summaries launched repeatedly
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: Reporter provides session counts, logs and model-level usage comparisons, describing background launches after out-of-credits errors.
incidents.limitation: Telemetry is supplied by the reporter; no independent reproduction or generalization to other platforms is claimed.

incidents.title: Credit deductions and recharge need reconciliation
incidents.status: Open in the reviewed page; no independent reproduction
incidents.evidence: Reporter describes an unexplained recharge amount and missing execution-level reconciliation for credit deductions.
incidents.limitation: Support statements are relayed by the user. No direct staff confirmation or proven reconnect cause is present in the reviewed report.

incidents.title: Small SVG task reports substantial context overhead
incidents.environment: macOS Codex Desktop, Sol High, CLI 0.155.0-alpha.9.2
incidents.status: Open user report; not independently reproduced
incidents.evidence: Reporter shows 887,076 input tokens, including 827,264 cached input, and 9,230 output tokens for a small task; unnecessary tool work is alleged.
incidents.limitation: Telemetry is supplied by the reporter. Does not prove incorrect billing, silent model substitution or independent root cause.

incidents.title: Watch-only: repeated historical image payloads
incidents.evidence: Reporter measures 30 retained images and 2.716 GiB of compressed request bodies over 64 requests in 30 minutes.
incidents.limitation: Bytes are not billed tokens or quota. Measurements date from September 18; independent reproduction and usage impact remain unverified.
